title: Project configuration (.devloops/devloops.json and .devloops/devloops.local.json)
description: Both files share this schema; the local file is deep-merged over the shared one. Relative paths resolve against the project root (the parent of .devloops/).

schema_version.description: The version of this file's format. Always 1.

workspace.description: The workspace commands use when --workspace is not given.

workspaces_dir.description: The folder that holds workspaces given by name, relative to the project root.

targets.description: The folder each loop writes its code to. A loop with a folder here is part of every run.

backend-dev.description: The folder the backend loop writes to, relative to the project root. null or missing: the project does not use the backend loop.

frontend-dev.description: The folder the frontend loop writes to, relative to the project root. null or missing: the project does not use the frontend loop.

requirements.description: The requirements a run reads when none is given on the command line: a file (path) or a spec-kit feature (speckit_feature), not both.
requirements.$comment: FR-011, FR-023, FR-024; exactly one of path and speckit_feature, checked in code (the validator has no oneOf); story_file only with path

path.description: The requirements file, relative to the project root.

story_file.description: true: the requirements file is one standalone story, not a whole product description.

speckit_feature.description: A spec-kit feature folder, or "active" for the feature spec-kit marks as active (.specify/feature.json).

config.description: Run configuration for this project: the same keys as a workspace's config.json.
